about.title: Who We Are
about.subtitle: Guardians of Bharatiya Parampara
about.description: Gau Samwardhan Ashram and Jankalyan Sanstha is a grassroots organization dedicated to ecological restoration, indigenous cow conservation, natural healing, and rural empowerment. Founded to revive Bharatiya parampara through self-reliant practices, we blend traditional knowledge with sustainable innovation to serve communities and protect nature.
about.visionText: To restore balance between human life, nature, and culture by promoting cow-centric, eco-friendly, and self-sustaining rural models.
missionPoints: Protect and promote indigenous cow breeds
Train rural communities in herbal wellness and zero-cost farming
Create models of swadeshi economy through cow-based enterprises
about.coreValuesDescription: Guiding principles that shape our approach to ecological restoration and community empowerment
about.traditionalWisdomDesc: Preserving and applying ancient knowledge systems for modern challenges
about.compassionateServiceDesc: Serving all beings with love, respect, and dedication to their wellbeing
about.sustainableInnovationDesc: Blending traditional practices with modern solutions for lasting impact

goMandir.title: Gau Mandir
goMandir.description: A sanctuary for native cows and a center for cultural, ecological, and economic revival. Water table raised from 410ft to 120ft, hundreds of acres revived, chemical-free agriculture, women's empowerment.

naturopathy.title: Prakratik Chikitsa (Naturopathy)
naturopathy.description: Ancient therapies using earth, water, fire, air, and ether. Personalized treatments, yoga, mud therapy, hydrotherapy, and diet-based interventions.

panchgavya.title: Panchgavya Chikitsa
panchgavya.description: Holistic healing using cow-derived elements (milk, curd, ghee, urine, dung). Consultations, therapies, and training available.
